scope: Proposition 18 (Convolution from the retained transform layout) of the manuscript “Integer multiplication below n log n” (preprints/Integer-multiplication-below-n-log-n-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 109 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 834f644c3ce67932), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 46-47. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under the hypotheses of Lemma 16, Mr on disk grid operands has an approximation with error less than √ 2 M(3ℓ + 1)2−p (32) and cost O  Tp h dK + pKτ−1 + ℓdλ′ + log(rp) i . Put mM = log2 M and wM = w + mM . The returned grid array is in the original array and coefficient order, with the same two’s-complement component format at width wM . The procedure 46 supplies Γ(wM ) on the output descriptor tape, so the caller knows every component boundary from this width and the retained shape parameters. If one operand has norm at most ρ < 1 and the bound in (32) is at most 1 − ρ, the returned grid array is a disk array.
